title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Result
description: Host-neutral per-row enrichment result emitted by the MCP enrich_inventory tool and the match-service /v1/enrich endpoint. The preferred template is identity + source_references: a match/no_match identity outcome and indexed public assurance source references. Compatibility projections such as match, sources, primary_source_by_type, and source_urls_by_type may remain for older adapters. The result never carries a compliance, suitability, approval, or risk conclusion.

row_id.description: The caller correlation id, echoed verbatim.

input.description: The bounded identity that was matched, echoed back.

identity.description: Preferred simplified identity template for MCP/API/agent users.

source_references.description: Preferred simplified source-reference template keyed by source type. Values are indexed public source references from the loaded OpenVA index, not live-check results or advisory conclusions.

match.description: Compatibility projection for older adapters. Prefer identity.match_status for new consumers.

sources.description: Compatibility projection containing indexed public source rows for the matched vendor, filtered by requested type, preserving original vendor-published URLs. Empty unless the match status is matched.

primary_source_by_type.description: Compatibility projection: the primary source object per source_type, chosen deterministically by the shared ranking.

source_urls_by_type.description: Compatibility projection: original source URLs grouped by source_type.

notes.description: Machine-state notes only (e.g. no indexed OpenVA match, multiple plausible entities, missing indexed source reference). Never a compliance conclusion.

not_advice.description: Always true. OpenVA returns indexed public source references, not advice.

status.description: Compatibility status. New consumers should map matched -> match; ambiguous -> no_match with no_match_reason=multiple_plausible_entities; no_match -> no_match with no_match_reason=no_indexed_openva_match.
